items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only completes the interviewer's sentence stating his father was a director of the band; no direct personal interaction or relationship with Jean Gene Goldkette is described.

ctx.x: Well, I don't know how you would call a feel for it (we have to go over this tape because it's going to be pretty awful). If you guide my hand in the recall now...Jean Gene Goldkette left Chicago. He was a very young fellow. He had left Chicago because this job came up for him in Detroit, Michigan. And he left Chicago out from under the wing of my father you might say.
And why your father? Why was your father involved?
